about: Regression for the v1.4.7 load reset restarting every transfer cage: saving while hobgoblin teams are mid-carry made each cage spawn a second team on load (hobgoblin population exploding, 34 -> 55) and the leftover team then drew an emptied cage and crashed (scr_draw_hobgoblin_carry, 'skin'). Seed 1 + save at frame 900 reproduced it on every seed tried.

steps.why: cancelling a stale transfer must not drop prisoners
